findings.comment: Multiple concurrent departmental reviews remain incomplete and pending: Fire (F1, F4 pending); Water Quality (WQ1-3, WQ9, WQ11, WQ13-14 pending); Drainage Engineering (DE3-4, DE6-14 pending); Transportation (TPW2, TPW18 pending); Austin Water Utility Development (AW1-2 pending); City Arborist (CA1-CA6 pending); Case Manager approval blocks (CM8, CM10, CM11 not cleared). Plan cannot be approved or released until all departmental reviews are completed.

Fire Department approval has not been completed. Two critical Fire Department comments remain pending: F1 (general Fire Department notes required on general notes sheet) and F4 (fire flow confirmation pending Service Extension Request documentation for wastewater service showing available 1,471 GPM is insufficient for reduced demand of 1,500 GPM). Approval must be obtained prior to site plan release.

findings.comment: Pipeline Engineering review and approval has not been completed. Review is in second-round status (9/29/25) with redline comments provided via Bluebeam link, but final approval has not been obtained. Written approval memo must be received and incorporated before site plan release.

Parks and Recreation Department review status is marked 'Pending' in first-round response cycle. While reviewer notes indicate the comment 'will be cleared prior to SP approval' and parkland dedication fee has been determined ($177,244.24 for 39 units), formal clearance and approval status cannot be verified until the second-round response confirms resolution.

CapMetro Right-of-Way Access Application requirement cannot be verified from submitted documents. No explicit determination is documented regarding site proximity to CapMetro rail right-of-way. Applicant must confirm whether site is adjacent to any CapMetro rail corridor and, if applicable, obtain RWIC from CapMetro Real Estate Department.

Public Works Department (Office of the City Engineer) approval requirement and completion status cannot be verified from Master Comment Report. No explicit OCE reviewer is identified in the departmental review roster; approval status is not documented. Clarification is needed regarding whether OCE review is required for this project and, if so, confirmation of approval must be obtained.

findings.comment: Fire line is present on utility plans (6-inch fire line per Sheet 18 water service), but Development Services Department (DSD) approval for the fire line as required by UCM 2.5.1.D is not explicitly documented. Written DSD approval must be obtained and submitted prior to site plan release.

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - Water Quality Review

findings.comment: Watershed Protection Department impervious cover allocation approval has not been explicitly documented in the submittal. While the proposed impervious cover (59.5-60%) is below the allowable cap (65%) and Water Quality review addresses IC treatment, formal written approval of the IC allocation by WPD is not confirmed in the available documents.

Public Utility Easement depiction and compliance cannot be fully verified from submitted site plan. Project facts identify recorded PUEs (7.5-foot easements from Cortez Heights and Mecey platting) that are not confirmed as clearly depicted on the site plan. Confirmation is required that all existing PUEs are shown on the plan and that no proposed buildings encroach within the easement boundaries; if any encroachment is proposed, PUE vacation documentation from Land Management must be obtained.

findings.comment: Owner's Letter of Recognition has not been provided and documented in the application package. This letter documents that no Certificate of Occupancy, Temporary Certificate of Occupancy, or water/wastewater meters will be released until all required infrastructure is installed, tested, and accepted per Austin Water requirements. Confirmation from the reviewing department is required regarding current applicability and submission status.
